Introducing Rally Tripmeter, the ultimate mobile app for rally drivers and co-drivers. Designed by a rally driver, Rally Tripmeter is the app you need to take your rally experience to the next level. With its advanced features, Rally Tripmeter will help you navigate the rally course with confidence, avoid penalties, and perform at your best.

Accurate Distance Measurement: Rally Tripmeter accurately measures multiple distances, providing you with the information you need to navigate the course with ease. The app's 10m accuracy ensures that you can trust the distances displayed on your screen.

Calculation of Time Control Times: Rally Tripmeter takes the stress out of calculating time control times. Simply input your start time, and the app will calculate your estimated time of arrival at each time control. This feature helps you stay on schedule and avoid penalties.

Display of Rally Time: Rally Tripmeter displays the rally time, so you can keep track of the time and ensure you're on pace for the finish. This feature is especially helpful for TSD rallies, where accuracy and consistency are crucial.

Avoid Speeding Fines During Recce: During the recce phase, drivers and co-drivers often find themselves navigating unfamiliar roads and may accidentally exceed the speed limit. Rally Tripmeter's built-in speedometer helps you avoid speeding fines by keeping you aware of your speed at all times.

Tracking Ideal Time for TSD Rallies: Rally Tripmeter helps you track your ideal time for TSD rallies, ensuring that you stay on pace and achieve your goals on the rally course.

Taking Stage Times: Rally Tripmeter allows you to take stage times, so you have all the information you need to perform at your best. Whether you're a seasoned professional or a beginner, Rally Tripmeter has everything you need to take your rally game to the next level.

Rally Tripmeter is lightweight and works well on both small and large devices, thanks to its automatically resizing texts. Whether you're looking for a backup or simply want to improve your performance, Rally Tripmeter is the app you need. Get it now and take your rally experience to the next level!

Russ Bray has refereed all major Professional Darts Corporation (PDC) tournaments including the World Championship final. He is widely considered to be the best darts referee in the world and was inducted into the PDC Hall of Fame in 2024.

In the app Russ referees your darts match in full including speaking your name, throws, total left, and shot-outs with his silky vocal tones exactly the same as TV.

Game, shot and the match to Russ Bray Darts Scorer Pro!

VERSUS (2 PLAYER):
You and a friend battle it out on the oche.

ONLINE (2 PLAYER):
Play remotely against friends without leaving your own homes (cross platform support).

PRACTICE ROOM (IMPROVE):
Improve your game by playing Bob's 27, Around The Clock, Scoring 99 and more.  Choose to play solo or against the computer.
Play X01 and Cricket against the computer.

TOURNAMENT (CHAMPIONSHIP):
Recreate the atmosphere of the big stage by playing Tournaments in your own home. Include human and virtual computer players, play knockout or league format with double in, random draw, sets or legs, seeded players and so much more.

TOUR (CAREER MODE):
Play a career mode with a full schedule of Tournaments. Earn money and see if you can finish top of the end of season rankings.

MULTI (3+ PLAYERS):
Unlimited number of players can contest a match, from three to thirty, the choice is yours.

PERFORMANCE CENTRE:
Numerous charts to track your progress over time

HEADLINE FEATURES:
- TV style presentation with gameplay on the Unicorn Eclipse Ultra dartboard.
- World professional referee Russ Bray calling all the shots exactly the same as TV.
- Personalised audio, hear Russ speak YOUR name (over 4000 names including nicknames).
- Voice Scoring. For fully fluid gameplay no need to mess about with keypads. Just speak your throws, retrieve your darts and Russ will call your match in full.
- Set your own custom start number between 101 and 9999.
- Cricket scoring.
- Save matches and resume them at any time.
- Match history and detailed stats for the current match and all past matches including average, first 9 average, best leg (darts thrown), highest checkout, highest throw, doubles hit, legs against throw and score counts (60's, 100's, 140's and 180's counts). 
- Individual throws are all recorded.
- Head to Head match stats.
- Score the total for the each throw or dart separately.
- Option to automatically switch entry mode to single dart when on a finish.
- ProScore option for manually tracking of missed doubles (MD), and darts thrown when finishing or busting a score.
- Option to have an open ended game (set winning target to 0).
- Play with leg or set scoring (3 or 5 leg sets).
- Averages and checkouts can be displayed when a finish is available.
- Bull up to decide starting player.
- Tie breaks to win by two clear legs.
- Play the computer at twenty skill levels.
- Play with handicaps.
- Real to life TrueThrow mechanics with the computer throwing intelligently depending on the match situation.
- Create your own computer players at any level (mimic the pro's).
- Play a computer version of yourself, your friends or any of the other human players.
- Undo any score including after the leg or match has finished.
